Results.ReviewText: I would love to give this grill 5 stars because over the last year, it has worked well, it's great looking, easy to clean, and has fired up well.  However, at near the one year mark, the grill stopped starting on one click, then stopped starting at all.  So I read the instructions and started with replacing the battery.  That didn't work.  I checked the wiring, that was OK.  So I called customer service, which was helpful, until the point they said I need a new starter.  The good news the new starter system is under warranty and free.  The bad news is that it's been 6 weeks since I called and I still don't have it.  I have no idea when it will come in.  Clearly they must be in demand, and it would seem there must be starter reliability issues with this grill.  I would still recommend Weber grills, since my previous grill lasted 20 years!

Results.ReviewText:
I splurged and bought this for myself because I've always wanted to own a Weber grill. So far, I have not been disappointed. 

Assembly was pretty easy...the instructions are probably the best I've ever seen for any sort of large appliance like this. There were a couple images in them that were wrong, but it was easy to figure out what they meant, so it didn't create a problem. My box was missing one of the screws that I needed, but Weber sent that to me pretty quickly.

The grill is very sturdy, and I expect it will last a long time. It reaches about 550 F within 10 minutes or so of turning it on.

In terms of grilling, I'm still learning about the hotspots and what temperature setting to use for various things. My main problem has been that even though I get the grill really hot and oil the grates before putting something on it, food seems to stick pretty easily. So far, I've made salmon, chicken and Cornish game hens with it, and they turned out pretty well, though it seemed as though I needed to cook things longer than I would've thought, so I guess I need to turn it up a bit higher than I would expect. 

The gas tank guage is probably one of the best features...it's nice not to have to worry about whether you have enough gas.
Results.Title: Sturdy grill with great assembly instructions

Results.ReviewText: It’s well made, although the starter is a tad slow.  The location of the gas canister is very good—easy to replace and see the gas gauge.  In the summer, I make most of our meals outside, so I need a flexible grill that is good at all temperatures and at the very least has an interior “floating” rack for foods that need indirect or lower temps while other food is cooking on the grill.  We bought the Weber for quality and size.  There are three problems with it:  it cannot do low and slow cooking (with one burner off and the other turned down all the way, it doesn’t go below 350 degrees when closed. That’s not low enough for brisket , pork shoulder or ribs); the floating rack is cheap, very narrow and stationary—that makes it difficult to cook anything that isn’t tiny and makes it difficult to clean; side burner?  C’mon, $150 grills have side burners, so they can’t be that expensive.  Something this small and this expensive should have a side burner.  For weekend grilling of burgers and steaks, this is a well-built grill that will probably last a long time.  For anything more complex, this grill is a waste of money.

Hello. We are very sorry to hear of your disappointment. If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips

1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.

2. Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.

3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming. 

4. The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

Please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team if you need additional assistance. We'll be happy to help. Thank you.

Results.ReviewText: This is a simple, effective, two-burner outdoor grill.  The assembly instructions are very clear (exceptionally so!), but it can take an hour or so to complete construction.  The parts appear to be well-made and well-coated — a consideration in Hawaii's tropical, moist climate.  After about three weeks' use, all is well.  If there is one gripe (minor), it is a lack of hand grips on the lift-up end of the grill to avoid the static plastic feet from dragging on the ground in order to change the grill's location; especially important when the grill is hot.  It seems a strange design oversight.  The one drop-down side table (on the lift-up end) isn't very stable or designed for this task.  But overall, this is a simple, efficient, cost-effective grill.  More bells and whistles are a choice and cost more!  You pays yer money and...
Results.Title: Does the business!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I replaced an older 2 burner grill with the Weber 210 model.  I didn't think the 210 size was going to be big enough for the family gatherings, but  the total grilling area is bigger then my old grill which was longer than the 210.  EZ start, Even cooking, EZ cleanup.  The tank hanger/fuel level gauge is a nice feature no other grill has. I've assembled grills for over 3 years for a major retailer and Weber is by far the winner  for quality of materials used.  No thin sheet metal on Weber.  The attention to detail extends to the vinyl washers used to prevent electro mechanical corrosion that occurs between different metals.  During my days assembling grills many people asked me what grill they should buy, my reply was always " if you want a grill that's well constructed and one that will last, buy a Weber".  

note: I do prefer the older style 210 with the solid sides and 4 wheels.  Too bad they changed designs.
Results.Title: A grill that will last for many years

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
